title: Japan Just Launched a Heist on a Mars Moon (MMX, Oct. 2026)
description:
Japan's MMX lifted off on an H3 rocket from Tanegashima on Oct. 20, 2026 (Oct. 19 UTC) to do something no mission has done: bring home a piece of a moon of Mars. The plan: reach Mars in August 2027, drop the 25 kg IDEFIX rover on Phobos, grab at least 10 grams with a coring arm and a nitrogen gas sampler, and land a capsule in Australia in 2031. Phobos is creeping about 1.8 m (6 ft) closer to Mars every 100 years.
